_comment: One flat item per call. `body` is the target's JSON response; `received_at` varies per run.

body.note: the shared key is not in this payload - the credential adds it as a header

refused_host.error: Stop and Error: 'P07 signed request: host example.com is not in allowed_hosts - the shared key only travels to hosts named in the "Allowed hosts" node' (no request is made; the caller's error lane or P01 sees this message)

missing_url.error: Stop and Error: 'P07 signed request: input item needs a url'

wrong_key_on_target: Not reachable from a workflow: the value is fixed by the credential. Reproduce from the host with `curl -i localhost:8080/secure/ping` (401) vs `curl -i -H 'X-Lab-Key: lab-demo-key' localhost:8080/secure/ping` (200).
